overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Toulose 2 Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features six strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels and an interior chromotherapy lighting system, enhancing your relaxation experience. With Bluetooth connectivity and built-in speakers, you can enjoy your favorite tunes while unwinding in temperatures up to 140°F.
